scope: Conservative AST inventory of direct execute/query calls in registered report functions. Location-dependent SQL assignment branches retain statically resolved variants, including a simple unconditional static string suffix after the branch. Positional bind arity is compared for static SQL and branch-correlated SQL when parameter counts are statically known. Unique, unshadowed module-level literal strings are resolved in SQL expressions; computed or reassigned module values remain unresolved. Named-bind keys are compared when literal mappings and simple branch-correlated condition-list appends are statically available; dynamic containers and nested conditional mutations remain unresolved. Literal same-module helper-return filters emit a branch signal only when a returned location predicate binds the caller's location_id argument. Direct require_network_scope(report_type, location_id) calls are recorded separately as network-attribution guards; they are not counted as bound farm filters or tenant authorization. A visible location predicate or bound location_id expression is only a source signal; it does not prove correct authorization, tenant isolation, view lineage, or semantic filtering. Helper behavior, database policies, dynamic SQL, and runtime inputs may change effective scope. No report is run, no query is executed, and no database, provider, saved query, or secret is accessed.
